error[ZBX-E0600]: this network mode is not available yet
  while  reading the command line
  cause  --net user needs user-mode networking through pasta, which zbx does not
         drive yet
  arg    user
  fix    run with no network (the default), or share the host's:   zbx run --net host alpine -- sh
  more   zbx explain E0600
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0600.html
